# HomeBusinessWatch.com

> Independent research site reviewing 500+ home business opportunities — MLMs, affiliate programs, direct sales, and work-from-home platforms. We analyze compensation plans, income disclosure statements, monthly costs, and real member experiences.

## What We Cover

- MLM company reviews with income disclosure data (Amway, Herbalife, Melaleuca, doTERRA, Young Living, and 200+ more)
- Affiliate program reviews and commission comparisons
- Direct sales company reviews
- Work-from-home and freelance platform reviews
- Industry news: company closures, FTC actions, comp plan changes
- Comparison pages (e.g., Amway vs HBA, Herbalife vs HBA)

## Our Rating System

Companies are rated 1-5 stars across five dimensions:
- Residual Potential: How much per customer, how stable
- Startup Simplicity: How easy to get started
- Transparency: Comp plan clarity, income disclosure quality
- Community & Support: Training, tools, accessibility
- Value for Cost: Monthly investment vs realistic return

## Income Data Sources

Where available, ratings incorporate data from official company Income Disclosure Statements (IDS). Key verified data:
- Amway (2023): Median active IBO earns $657/year before expenses
- Herbalife (2024): Median established distributor earns ~$3,216/year
- Melaleuca (2022): 82% of members earn $0; monthly 35 product points required
- Young Living: ~94% of distributors earn near $0; median $4/year for business builders
- doTERRA: 91% of Wellness Advocates earn $0

## Editor's Pick

Home Business Academy (HBA) — rated 4.8/5. One-tier affiliate model, 80% commissions, never changed comp plan since 2016. See: https://homebusinesswatch.com/companies/home-business-academy
